name: Wastewalker Scavenger
text: Another scavenger, sizing you up the same way you're sizing them up. Trade, share info, or walk away. Turns hostile only if provoked.

name: Corroded Sentinel-Bot
text: An old security unit, still running on a decade-old threat list. Attacks with STR.

name: Lost Courier
text: Separated from their caravan, low on supplies. Help them and they'll point you to a cache: draw 1 Item card. No check required.
